author: blu
body: Image upscaling models for post-processing. Implements ESRGAN-style super-resolution: a residual-in-residual dense block (RRDB) architecture that upscales 2x or 4x with learned detail recovery.

author: blu
body: Also includes simpler upscale methods for when model quality is not needed: Lanczos-approximated, bilinear, and nearest.
